map.出境旅游/海淘前，手动填入银行或外汇平台实时汇率，把本币金额换算成目标币，离线估: Before travel abroad or shopping overseas, manually enter the live bank or platform rate to convert local currency into the target currency and estimate offline how much you can get, without being misled by vague counter quotes.
map.对比两个兑换渠道（银行牌价 vs 机场/商户）时，分别填入汇率与手续费，算出到手: When comparing two exchange channels (bank quote vs airport or merchant), enter the rate and fee for each to compute the net amount and pick the better one.
map.持有多币种时，按「1 原始=？目标」双向换算，生成速查表，途中快速心算小额消费。: Holding multiple currencies, convert bidirectionally with "1 source = ? target" to build a quick reference table for fast mental math on small purchases.
map.输入汇率 1 CNY=0.138 USD、手续费 0%：到手=10000×0.1: Entering rate 1 CNY=0.138 USD and fee 0%: net = 10,000×0.138×(1-0) = 1,380 USD. If the channel charges 1.5% fee: net = 10,000×0.138×0.985 = 1,359.3 USD, and the 20.7 USD difference is the fee cost. In reverse USD→CNY use rate 1/0.138≈7.246, so 100 USD≈724.6 CNY. Note: the rate depends on the live quote you enter; bank buy and sell rates differ, and the actual net amount uses the cash buying rate.
map.用你实际兑换渠道的「卖出价」（你用本币买外币的价格）；若查到的是中间价，到手会略: Use the "ask rate" of your actual exchange channel (the price at which you buy foreign currency with local currency); if you found the mid rate, the net amount is slightly lower. Cash and remittance quotes also differ, and the cash buying rate is lower.

map.本工具纯前端、结果完全取决于你填入的汇率与手续费，不含任何隐藏点差；与银行 Ap: This tool is purely front-end and the result depends entirely on the rate and fee you enter, with no hidden spread; differences from a bank app come from quote timing and buy/sell direction, not from a calculation error.
